CheckTitle: Ensure unused user console access for 45 days or more is disabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks for IAM users whose console password has not been used in 45 days or more.
Risk: Unused console passwords are dormant credentials that can be phished or brute-forced without anyone noticing.

Recommendation.Text: Remove the login profile of users that have not signed in for 45 days.
